clearentEmailId.description: The email address associated with the person paying. Usually the same as the person who is making the booking.

clearentZip.description: The zip code of the person who is paying for the booking. Usually the same as the person who is making the booking.

first_available.description: First available date for each service. If the provider has no availability this will be null.

size.description: Number of participants in the group

memberAddMode.description: Group allows members to add participants

linkedParent.description: If the group is part of a community this is the ID of the community
